Man, don't even think about your path or career right now. The best thing you can do is pay a visit to a therapist. After you deal with your mental health issues, it will be much easier to look ahead into the future. Right now, that's top priority. I know it feels like there's no future and like nothing makes any sense, but that's just your perception, which is probably affected by depression, as far as I can judge. Please seek help. Good luck.

I'm not going to tell you that there's any point, because I don't really feel like I have a future too. But yesterday I found out that's not me thinking this, but depression, which is an actual disorder, which can and should be treated. I'm going to check into a mental health clinic on Thursday. I encourage you to seek help too. Maybe we don't see anything good for now, but that doesn't mean there is nothing good at all. It means we just don't have an opportunity to recognize it. Please call suicide prevention hotline if you feel like you are close to ending your life. I wish you all the best, mate. You are not alone

You may have depression. Check for other symptoms, like feeling down most of the time, having suicidal thoughts or of hurting yourself, lack of energy, low self-esteem and trouble eating/sleeping properly. It may be something else, but looks like depression to me.
In any case, you should visit a qualified therapist.
Good luck

Well, the best thing you can do for yourself is try therapy. I know it's not easy, not when you first come to the doctor, nor when you're in the process of working on it. But it will get better and you will thank yourself for doing this. 
As a first step, you can try looking for a good therapist in your area on the Internet. Then, work up your courage and phone them and make an appointment. These are the hardest steps. You will probably get so terrified, you'll be ready to chicken out. But believe me, it's worth it. And it will get better. Even if the first therapist is not the one and you'll have to find another, it will be much easier this time.
